senses.gloss: same, trnsf. (with ב) to belittle, make light of.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:11">Koh. R. to III, 11</cite> <he>אילו אחד … הוא פ׳ בממונו של עולם וכ׳</he> if any one else had said, ‘vanity of vanities &c.’ (<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:2">ib. I, 2</cite>), I might have thought, one that never owned two pennies in his life, made light of the wealth of the world &c.
